result.reason: The clause adds the annual frequency limit, business-hours restriction, and auditor confidentiality, while retaining an independent auditor and the 5% cost threshold. However, it does not prohibit direct access to Licensee systems, and “within 30 days” does not require 30 days’ advance written notice. The cost shift also applies to any “discrepancy,” rather than specifically an underpayment exceeding 5%. The added non-interference condition is reasonable but exceeds the stated playbook requirements, and the relocation of the cost paragraph is unnecessary. The underlying audit right and general commercial intent are otherwise preserved.
